description:
Hello,
Greetings!!!!!


My name is Venkat and I am a Talent Acquisition Executive with TekWissen LLC. I came across your resume and wanted to let you know about an opportunity we have that might be of interest to you. I have attached the description below. If you are interested, please send me your updated resume and the best time and number I can reach you at.

 Job Title : SOA Developer
Location  : Mclean VA
Duration: Long Term

* 5-8 years of experience in Solution, Design and Development of web applications using the Java EE, Webservices, JMS, XML, Weblogic.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent working experience
* 1-2 years of experience in desginging webservices, SOA based applications.
* Strong hands on experience with Spring, Apache CXF, JAXB and JMS
* Experience in designing architecture, reusable components and frameworks.
* Integration experience using Web Services and EJB preferably on Weblogic platform
* Expert in Object Oriented Analysis and Design using Java and UML
* Expert in JEE patterns and ability to use commonly used on in real time situations
* Expert in tuning all tiers of applications on JEE platform.
* Good knowledge of database concepts with working knowledge on SQL and Stored Procedures.
* Strive to constantly improve the application development processes and tools.
* Hands on 1 - 2 years of experience in Oracle Enterprise Service Bus

 



 
 Kindly reply to Venkat at tekwissen dot com
 
 734-550-4449

 Thanks
 Venkat
